text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spot Rice Shower by the<n>Three
Goddesses statue, staring into<n>the fountain.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I heard that if you pray to the<n>Goddesses and toss
a coin into the<n>fountain, they'll make your wish
come true.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
And... I want to become someone<n>who can bring
happiness to everyone<n>around me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That's such a big thing to ask for,<n>though... so I
wasn't sure how many<n>coins to toss.
choice_data_list: Put all your heart into one coin.
How about a coin for each Goddess?
Try tossing in a whole bunch!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Okay! I'll try to squeeze all my<n>thoughts into it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Three Goddesses... Please make<n>my wish come
true!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Brother, guess what! I didn't<n>bring misfortune
to anyone today!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Sister, guess what! I didn't bring<n>misfortune to
anyone today!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Nothing went wrong, and everyone<n>had a nice,
happy day.
choice_data_list: The Goddesses must have heard your prayer.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I hope so... It feels like they did, at<n>least.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? The fountain stopped...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Okay! I'll try to squeeze all my<n>thoughts into them.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Three Goddesses... Please make<n>my wish come
true!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wait, is this—we got a winning<n>popsicle stick!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um, Big Brother? Would you eat the<n>winning one?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um, Big Sister? Would you eat the<n>winning one?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I want to give this good luck to<n>you... and make
you happy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I want to give this good luck to<n>you... and make
you happy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... The Goddesses must have<n>granted my
wish.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? The fountain stopped...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Okay! I'll try to squeeze all my<n>thoughts into them.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Three Goddesses... Please make<n>my wish come
true!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Eep! I'm so sorry! I didn't mean to<n>knock into you...

text_block_list.name: Moça A
text_block_list.text: Y-You're a life-saver!

text_block_list.name: Moça A
text_block_list.text:
That car there just ran a red. If you<n>hadn't pushed
me off the crosswalk,<n>it would've hit me... Thank
you so<n>much!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? I... I did something good?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Three Goddesses... Thank you for<n>granting my
wish.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? The fountain stopped...

text_block_list.name: Janitor
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, there's a coin blocking the<n>drainpipe. I guess
there must've<n>been a lot of students offering
prayers, huh? Oh well, it was overdue<n>for a cleaning
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh no... This is all my fault.
choice_data_list: That's not true. It could've been anyone's coin.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
No! It's always my fault when<n>something goes
wrong! Always...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um, Mr. Janitor! I'll help clean the<n>fountain!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother... Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister... Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Janitor
text_block_list.text:
Whew! Thanks, you two. We got that<n>done lightning
fast!
choice_data_list: You were a good helper, Rice.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
M-me? But it's my fault it was<n>clogged in the first
place...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm just glad we were able to get it<n>cleaned up...
